name: echodesk-monorepo
description: EchoDesk - AI Voice Agent & Field Operations CRM Monorepo

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgGreen.bold" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build && cd mobile && flutter analyze
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && cd mobile && flutter test
